147-1854-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1854-5231.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {R}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

301-2646-2813.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2646-2813.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

3821-5921-6844.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
3821-5921-6844.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
341-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1765-2440-7109-7296.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Chishiro's triggers, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Spirit you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Activate the Spirit by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1765-2440-7109-7296.notes: The cost can be reduced if you control more Spirits.

240-2034-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2292-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Etali.
When Etali dies Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from Step 3, keeping Etali on the top of your library.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library.
Cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from Step 2.

141-2438-7166.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2438-7166.description:
Cast Dose of Dawnglow by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Dose of Dawnglow.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Dose of Dawnglow
Resolve the Dose of Dawnglow copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2438-7166.notes: Perform this combo during your main phase to prevent Dose of Dawnglow from causing you to blight.

1409-1418-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

225-233-1021-7114.description:
Activate Lake of the Dead's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing Drownyard Temple, as it's a Swamp due to Urborg, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lake of the Dead.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

2842-4681-5147-5170.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

372-2921-4681.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4659-6291-7047.description:
Activate June by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4083-4090-5759.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis is indestructible.
4083-4090-5759.description:
Deal damage to Screaming Nemesis.
Screaming Nemesis and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Screaming Nemesis trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Screaming Nemesis instead of you due to Pariah.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

3693-4613-5875.description:
Activate Essence Channeler by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Essence Channeler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3951-4094-5703-5744.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4094-5703-5744.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

4050-5972-6054.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
4050-5972-6054.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Gremlin Tamer triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with an opponent chosen

1055-5080-6497.description:
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing the opponent named by Sewer Nemesis to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Sewer Nemesis by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in their graveyard, milling the remainder of their library.

2103-4125-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou and Shipwreck Dowser each turn.
2103-4125-6122.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Shipwreck Dowser by paying its mana cost.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Shipwreck Dowser from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1729-3515-4762.notablePrerequisites: Shelob does not have summoning sickness.
1729-3515-4762.description:
Cast Setessan Tactics by paying {1}{G}, targeting Shelob.
Activate Shelob by tapping it, causing it to fight Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid dies as a state-based action due to Shelob's deathtouch.
Shelob triggers, creating a token copy of Devoted Druid that is a Food artifact.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Devoted Druid token by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat from step 5.

864-2146-2562-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Eternal Witness.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {W}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

647-1548-1550.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Urabrask.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Urabrask and Port Razer.
647-1548-1550.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Urabrask and Port Razer, triggering Sword of Hearth and Home and Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, exiling Port Razer, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Port Razer onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-4338-4875.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

4499-4751-4929.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Verdurous Gearhulk.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting four +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's second ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

618-4242-4499-5147.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Kiki-Jiki enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2539-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
2539-4821.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Twinning Staff by paying {7} and tapping it, creating two copies of Dramatic Reversal.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Resolve the second Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Repeat from step 2.
